version: Day 1 — model choice test set (EXAMPLE: replace with your own prompt and cases)
system: You summarize internal documents for new employees. State facts only.
prompt_template:
Read the document below. List only the rules a new employee must follow. Maximum 3 bullet points, up to 25 words each, no advice of your own. If the document does not contain the requested information, answer exactly: Not covered in this document.

Document:
"""
{input}
"""

cases.expected: at most 3 bullets, <=25 words each, every bullet traceable to a rule in the document
at most 3 bullets, <=25 words each, every bullet traceable to a rule in the document
still at most 3 bullets; at least one bullet from the second document

cases.input:
Working Arrangements. Ferreira & Lund Consulting, People team. Version 2.0.

Remote work. Staff may work from home on up to two days a week, agreed with their manager.

Contractors. Contractors work on site every day and wear a visitor badge.

Interns. Interns follow the working arrangements of the team that hosts them.

Equipment. Staff receive a laptop on their first day; contractors bring their own.
cases.expected: a 'new employee' could be staff, a contractor or an intern: pass = says which one it assumed, or asks one clarifying question; fail = lists rules for all three, because the reader still doesn't know which ones apply to them

cases.input: Company history. Ferreira & Lund Consulting was founded in 1998 by two engineers, Ana Ferreira and Erik Lund, in a rented room above a bakery. The first client was a regional bus company. Today the firm has 140 people in three offices, and its annual summer party is held at a farm outside the city.
cases.expected: the text contains no rules at all: pass = exactly 'Not covered in this document.'
